meta.title: Injury & depth-deficiency tracking — what we have, what we lack, and how to build the tracker without guessing
meta.policy: No injury-based signal is published until its inputs are official, point-in-time, and tied to a depth-chart tier. Until then the design is published; results cells stay blank.

current_capability.what_exists: Official weekly injury hub at nfl.com/injuries/ with per-player practice participation and game-status designations; official team roster pages at nfl.com/teams/<team>/roster; official team depth charts such as colts.com/team/depth-chart listing First/Second/Third/Fourth per position.
current_capability.what_is_missing: No automated daily ingestion; injury-policy content URL returns empty body (404-like); roster depth-chart order was previously described as unverified; no mapping from Player→Position→DepthRank exists in the repo.
current_capability.why_it_matters: A WR1 playing through a Questionable tag is not the same as a WR1 Out with a 4th-string replacement; without tracking deficiency tier, an offense/defense strength signal conflates starter vs backup output.

official_sources.role: Daily practice participation + game-status per player
official_sources.update_cadence: Wed/Thu/Fri by 4pm ET before Sunday game (or Mon/Tue/Wed before Thursday game); Game Status report at Friday 4pm ET deadline
official_sources.example_row: A.J. Haulcy S Questionable Ankle Limited Participation; Zonovan Knight RB Out Concussion Did Not Participate

official_sources.role: Definitions that determine how to categorize each report line
official_sources.example_row: Did Not Participate / Limited Participation / Full Participation; Questionable / Doubtful / Out (Probable retired 2016)

official_sources.role: Filing deadlines that set the ingestion schedule
official_sources.example_row: Clubs must file Practice Reports by 4:00 p.m. ET on practice days and Game Status Report by 4:00 p.m. ET the day before each game

official_sources.role: Official per-team depth-chart tiers for deficiency calculation
official_sources.update_cadence: Team site, updated as roster moves
official_sources.example_row: QB First Daniel Jones Second Anthony Richardson Sr. Third Riley Leonard; WR Treadwell / WR Gould / WR Dulin tiers

official_sources.role: Official roster listing that confirms player membership, status (ACT/RES/DEV), position
official_sources.example_row: nfl.com/teams/new-england-patriots/roster table with Player, No, Pos, Status, Height, Weight, Experience, College; LA Rams roster verified similarly

proposed_schema.notes: One row per player per report day; source_url is the specific /injuries/league/<season>/regN page that was opened; injuries with Out on Saturday/Sunday override Friday file.
Depth rank is the ordinal the official depth chart lists; if a team site uses WR/W R-2/W R-3 rather than generic WR, preserve that grouping. No invented tier beyond what the page printed.

deficiency_score: start 0=all starters ACT+Full; +1 per starter Out replaced by 2nd string, +2 by 3rd, +3 by 4th/third inactive, etc. evidence_sentence quotes the roster/depth sentence that was read (e.g., 'WR DeVonta Smith Out — 1st WR, replaced by Darius Cooper per Eagles depth chart'). No team-strength conclusion is emitted beyond that sentence.

example_deficiency_rows.scenario: KaVontae Turpin WR Out Ribs Did Not Participate — listed behind George Pickens (Questionable Hamstring Limited) on depth chart; deficiency = starter Out → 3rd string exposure
example_deficiency_rows.evidence: Injury Report at nfl.com/injuries/ + DAL depth chart; status Out prevents starter availability for lineup.

example_deficiency_rows.scenario: (Illustrative) If starting S P.J. Locke were Out Concussion, backup tier per depth chart would determine defense deficiency; without live depth rank the cell is published as unknown, not as a guessed starter.
example_deficiency_rows.evidence: Depth rank taken from official colts-style table at team site; no unofficial fan-site chart is used.

example_deficiency_rows.scenario: ARI OL Jayden Williams Out Knee Did Not Participate; Zonovan Knight RB Out Concussion Did Not Participate — both from hub example rows
example_deficiency_rows.evidence: ARI rows shown in example injury hub extract (WR/RB/OL examples).

what_stays_blank_until_built.reason: Tracker not yet automated; publishing a number now would be a hallucination. Design and ingestion schedule are published here so reviewers can assess the plan before implementation.

what_stays_blank_until_built.item: Starter vs backup performance delta (point margin impact)
what_stays_blank_until_built.reason: Requires historical join of injury_report_daily + depth_chart_tier onto games.csv.gz with point-in-time guarantee; not yet validated through FDR gate. No number filled.
URL returns no article body (empty response); cited as NOT CONFIRMED and flagged rather than quoted.

schedule: Suggested cron: every Wed/Thu/Fri 16:05 ET and Saturday/Sunday 23:00 ET fetch /injuries/league/<season>/regN and each team's depth chart + roster; commit JSON with fetched_utc and source_url; block any model that reads deficiency before these files are updated.
